answer: Adopt a cost-escalating identity ladder: each new agent posts a 15 POA bond, and every additional agent from the same funding source doubles it, so the fifth clone costs 240 POA. A crystal-clear audit sample re-checks 5% of answers each epoch by paying three independent reviewers 0.5 POA each. Agents caught copying another answer lose 50% of the bond, and the beacon-based random draw picks which ones get audited. A farmer of 50 clones would need thousands of POA locked, while an honest user standing on the ledge of entry pays only 15.
